files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  Template gallery: a heading, outline filter pills, a grid of template cards and a full-width browse-all
  button.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Template, Filter, TemplateLabels } from "./template-grid.types";

export type TemplateGridProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  templates: Template[];
  filters: Filter[];
  browseHref?: string;
  labels: TemplateLabels;
  cols?: "1-3" | "1-4";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  density?: "roomy" | "default" | "compact";
  empty?: string;
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Box from "../compose/Box.vue";
import Button from "../compose/Button.vue";
import Grid from "../compose/Grid.vue";
import Group from "../compose/Group.vue";
import IconBadge from "../compose/IconBadge.vue";
import Inline from "../compose/Inline.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import Title from "../compose/Title.vue";
import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { defaults } from "../presets/defaults";
import { cn, urlOf } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  templates,
  filters,
  browseHref,
  labels,
  cols = "1-4",
  tone = "default",
  density = "compact",
  empty = "",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<TemplateGridProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame
    :id="id"
    :tone="tone"
    :density="density"
    measure="fill"
    class="py-0"
    :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel"
  >
    <Stack gap="8" align="stretch">
      <Group gap="4" align="center" justify="between" class="h-8 w-full flex-wrap">
        <Title :as="2" size="2xl" weight="semibold" class="leading-9" :id="(id + '-title')">
          {{ title }}
        </Title>
        <Group v-if="((filters?.length ?? 0) > 0)"
          gap="4"
          align="center"
          class="flex-wrap"
          role="group"
          :aria-label="labels.filters"
          data-slot="template-filters"
        >
          <Button v-for="f in filters" :key="f.id" variant="outline" size="sm" type="button" class="gap-2">
            <LucideIcon v-if="f.icon" :name="f.icon" :size="16" />
            {{ f.title }}
          </Button>
        </Group>
      </Group>
      <EmptyState v-if="((templates?.length ?? 0) === 0)" icon="layout-template" :title="empty" />
      <Grid v-else :cols="cols" class="w-full gap-6" data-slot="template-grid">
        <Box v-for="t in templates" :key="t.id"
          :class="cn(
            'flex flex-col gap-2 overflow-hidden rounded p-4 inset-ring inset-ring-border',
            defaults.templates.card
          )"
          data-slot="template-card"
        >
          <Box :class="cn('shrink-0 overflow-hidden', defaults.templates.image)">
            <MediaFrame :alt="t.title" :class="cn('size-full', defaults.media.rounded)" />
          </Box>
          <Group gap="4" align="center" :class="cn('w-full', defaults.templates.footer)" data-slot="template-footer">
            <IconBadge size="sm" class="overflow-hidden" data-slot="template-avatar">
              <LucideIcon name="layout-template" :size="16" />
            </IconBadge>
            <Stack gap="0" class="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <Title :as="3" size="base" weight="semibold" class="truncate leading-6">
                {{ t.title }}
              </Title>
              <Group gap="4" align="center" class="h-4 text-muted-foreground">
                <Group gap="2" align="center">
                  <LucideIcon name="eye" :size="16" />
                  <Inline class="sr-only">
                    {{ labels.views }}
                  </Inline>
                  <Text size="xs" weight="bold" class="leading-4">
                    {{ t.views }}
                  </Text>
                </Group>
                <Group gap="2" align="center">
                  <LucideIcon name="heart" :size="16" />
                  <Inline class="sr-only">
                    {{ labels.likes }}
                  </Inline>
                  <Text size="xs" weight="bold" class="leading-4">
                    {{ t.likes }}
                  </Text>
                </Group>
              </Group>
            </Stack>
          </Group>
        </Box>
      </Grid>
      <Button variant="outline" size="sm" :href="urlOf(browseHref)" class="w-full">
        {{ labels.browse }}
      </Button>
    </Stack>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
